categories: Economic security and freedom from desperation

bills.title: Automatic Benefits Enrollment Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Eligible people miss benefits because applications are complex.
bills.proposedChange: Offer automated eligibility checks and opt-in enrollment for existing benefits, with secure records and clear appeals.
bills.safeguards: Prevent incorrect enrollment, intrusive data sharing, and mistaken eligibility decisions.
bills.metrics: Eligible residents receiving benefits; application hours saved.

bills.title: Child Poverty Reduction Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Child poverty undermines health, stability, and opportunity.
bills.proposedChange: Create a refundable monthly child tax credit that reaches families with the lowest incomes.
bills.safeguards: Assess fiscal cost, benefit phase-outs, and interactions with other assistance.
bills.metrics: Child poverty rate; material hardship among families.

bills.title: Make Work Pay Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Low-wage work can leave households unable to meet essential expenses.
bills.proposedChange: Expand earned-income tax credits, including support for workers without dependent children.
bills.safeguards: Design smooth phase-outs and guard against filing complexity and fraud.
bills.metrics: After-tax income of low-wage workers; take-up rates.

bills.title: Free Automatic Tax Filing Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Routine tax filings consume time and money.
bills.proposedChange: Provide free prefilled tax returns when government information is sufficient, with correction and opt-out routes.
bills.safeguards: Protect sensitive data and preserve choice of tax preparer.
bills.metrics: Median filing time; taxpayer error rate; total filing cost.

bills.title: Emergency Savings Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Small financial shocks can trigger costly debt and instability.
bills.proposedChange: Match qualified savings for lower-income households up to a modest emergency reserve.
bills.safeguards: Ensure withdrawals remain accessible and program administration is affordable.
bills.metrics: Households with emergency reserves; high-cost borrowing incidence.

bills.title: Anti-Predatory Lending Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: High-cost lending can trap borrowers in repeated debt.
bills.proposedChange: Limit exploitative financing charges, disclose total costs clearly, and expand affordable lending options.
bills.safeguards: Monitor credit availability so restrictions do not push borrowers into worse alternatives.
bills.metrics: Repeat high-cost borrowing; loan default rates.

bills.title: Proportional Fines Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Fixed civil penalties can be devastating to low-income people.
bills.proposedChange: Introduce means-sensitive civil fines for suitable offenses and fair ability-to-pay hearings.
bills.safeguards: Protect equal treatment and avoid collecting more personal financial information than necessary.
bills.metrics: Fine-related defaults; collection costs; appeals outcomes.

bills.title: Medical Debt Relief Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Medical bills can produce prolonged financial hardship.
bills.proposedChange: Restrict abusive medical-debt collection and provide income-sensitive repayment and hardship protections.
bills.safeguards: Define eligible debts carefully and examine consequences for care prices and providers.
bills.metrics: Medical-debt delinquency; household financial distress.

bills.title: Portable Benefits Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Changing jobs can disrupt benefits and savings.
bills.proposedChange: Make retirement saving and specified worker benefits portable across employers and eligible independent work.
bills.safeguards: Prevent employers from replacing protected employment benefits with weaker arrangements.
bills.metrics: Benefit coverage across job transitions; retirement contributions.

bills.title: Start a Business in One Day Act
bills.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
bills.problem: Unnecessary registration delays discourage entrepreneurship.
bills.proposedChange: Create a consolidated online registration process and simpler rules for genuinely low-risk businesses.
bills.safeguards: Retain safety, labor, tax, and consumer protections where needed.
bills.metrics: Median business registration time; startup compliance cost.

bills.title: Freedom to Build Housing Act
bills.problem: Housing shortages push rents and prices beyond many households' reach.
bills.proposedChange: Enable more homes and mixed-use development near jobs and transit where infrastructure allows.
bills.safeguards: Account for displacement, utilities, local governance, and infrastructure capacity.
bills.metrics: Homes permitted; rent burden; construction completion time.

bills.title: Backyard Homes Act
bills.problem: Restrictive zoning blocks small, flexible housing options.
bills.proposedChange: Allow code-compliant accessory dwelling units on residential properties.
bills.safeguards: Maintain fire access, habitability, and reasonable infrastructure requirements.
bills.metrics: Accessory units completed; median housing costs.

bills.title: 30-Day Permit Decision Act
bills.problem: Unpredictable permit delays add cost to housing construction.
bills.proposedChange: Set service deadlines for routine, complete residential permit applications without waiving safety review.
bills.safeguards: Fund permitting offices and define exceptions for complex proposals.
bills.metrics: Median permit processing days; reversal and safety outcomes.

bills.title: Public Land for Homes Act
bills.problem: Unused suitable public land could support needed housing.
bills.proposedChange: Offer surplus public parcels through transparent processes prioritizing durable affordability and mixed-income homes.
bills.safeguards: Safeguard ecological, public-access, and community uses; prevent sweetheart deals.
bills.metrics: Affordable homes delivered; public land value retained.

bills.title: Housing First Stabilization Act
bills.problem: People experiencing chronic homelessness struggle to regain stability.
bills.proposedChange: Expand permanent supportive housing paired with voluntary, individualized health and social services.
bills.safeguards: Provide long-term services and evaluate local outcomes rather than assuming one model fits all.
bills.metrics: Chronic homelessness; housing retention; emergency-service use.

bills.title: Honest Rent Pricing Act
bills.problem: Hidden mandatory fees make housing prices difficult to compare.
bills.proposedChange: Require rental listings to disclose the total mandatory recurring cost and key one-time fees.
bills.safeguards: Keep disclosures consistent without obscuring legitimate optional charges.
bills.metrics: Disclosed all-in rents; fee-related complaints.

bills.title: Prevent Homelessness Before It Happens Act
bills.problem: Temporary shocks can trigger eviction and loss of housing.
bills.proposedChange: Provide targeted emergency rental aid, mediation, and eviction diversion for households at acute risk.
bills.safeguards: Target assistance fairly and test whether interventions prevent homelessness cost-effectively.
bills.metrics: Evictions avoided; returns to stable housing.

bills.title: Healthy Homes Act
bills.problem: Unsafe housing exposes residents to lead, mold, and other hazards.
bills.proposedChange: Require effective remediation of serious hazards with assistance for qualifying property owners and tenants.
bills.safeguards: Avoid displacing tenants during repairs and make inspections reliable.
bills.metrics: Hazard remediation rates; housing-related illness.

bills.title: Walkable Neighborhoods Act
bills.problem: Car-dependent neighborhoods limit access to everyday essentials.
bills.proposedChange: Support safe sidewalks, connected crossings, mixed-use destinations, and accessible routes.
bills.safeguards: Adapt designs to local needs, disability access, and maintenance budgets.
bills.metrics: Residents with safe walking access to services; pedestrian injuries.

bills.title: Climate-Resilient Homes Act
bills.problem: Flood, heat, and storm exposure threaten household security.
bills.proposedChange: Offer targeted grants for insulation, flood protection, storm resilience, and efficient cooling.
bills.safeguards: Use transparent risk criteria and avoid subsidizing unsafe rebuilding repeatedly.
bills.metrics: Homes retrofitted; disaster losses; indoor heat exposure.

bills.title: Affordable Essential Healthcare Act
bills.problem: People delay necessary care because of coverage gaps and cost.
bills.proposedChange: Offer affordable access to essential preventive, primary, and catastrophic care through coverage reforms.
bills.safeguards: Compare financing pathways, provider capacity, and fiscal sustainability.
bills.metrics: Care delayed due to cost; preventable hospitalizations.

bills.title: Primary Care Everywhere Act
bills.problem: Underserved communities lack timely access to primary care.
bills.proposedChange: Expand clinics and medical training incentives in areas with documented service shortages.
bills.safeguards: Avoid building facilities without a sustainable clinical workforce.
bills.metrics: Primary care appointment waits; clinician access by region.

bills.title: Mental Health Parity Enforcement Act
bills.problem: Mental healthcare coverage can be harder to use than physical healthcare coverage.
bills.proposedChange: Audit and enforce existing mental-health parity standards, with meaningful remedies for violations.
bills.safeguards: Measure real appointment access, not just written insurance policies.
bills.metrics: Mental-health claim denials; wait times; parity compliance.

bills.title: Community Mental Health Crisis Response Act
bills.problem: Traditional emergency responses are not always suited to behavioral-health crises.
bills.proposedChange: Fund trained mental-health crisis response teams and coordinated emergency pathways.
bills.safeguards: Protect responders and patients; ensure escalation for acute safety threats.
bills.metrics: Safe crisis resolutions; repeat emergency calls; response time.

bills.title: Healthy Mothers and Babies Act
bills.problem: Families face avoidable gaps in prenatal and postpartum support.
bills.proposedChange: Increase access to prenatal, postpartum, and voluntary family support services.
bills.safeguards: Respect patient choice and tailor care for rural and high-risk communities.
bills.metrics: Maternal morbidity; postpartum care access; infant outcomes.

bills.title: Addiction Recovery Access Act
bills.problem: Evidence-based addiction treatment is often difficult to obtain.
bills.proposedChange: Expand medication-assisted treatment, counseling, recovery support, and appropriate diversion programs.
bills.safeguards: Protect voluntary informed care and monitor treatment quality.
bills.metrics: Treatment initiation and retention; overdose deaths.

bills.title: Preventive Healthcare Access Act
bills.problem: Cost and access barriers delay prevention and early diagnosis.
bills.proposedChange: Reduce out-of-pocket and geographic barriers to recommended preventive care.
bills.safeguards: Use evidence-based recommendations and monitor unnecessary screening harms.
bills.metrics: Preventive service uptake; late-stage diagnosis rates.

bills.title: Rural Healthcare Freedom Act
bills.problem: Rural patients face long travel times and limited medical services.
bills.proposedChange: Fund mobile services, telehealth, and emergency-care capacity where regional need is documented.
bills.safeguards: Address broadband, reimbursement, quality, and continuity of care.
bills.metrics: Travel time to essential services; avoidable rural transfers.

bills.title: Affordable Medicines Competition Act
bills.problem: Insufficient competition can keep medicine prices high.
bills.proposedChange: Improve timely generic and biosimilar competition and transparent prescription pricing.
bills.safeguards: Preserve drug quality, innovation incentives, and reliable supplies.
bills.metrics: Out-of-pocket medicine spending; generic uptake; shortages.

bills.title: Healthy Food Access Act
bills.problem: Some households cannot reliably access nutritious food.
bills.proposedChange: Expand nutritious-food incentives and support viable grocery access in underserved areas.
bills.safeguards: Avoid stigmatizing recipients and verify that retailers deliver usable access.
bills.metrics: Food insecurity; fruit and vegetable access; food affordability.

bills.title: Affordable Childcare for Every Family Act
bills.problem: Childcare costs restrict family choices and economic participation.
bills.proposedChange: Scale quality childcare capacity and offer means-sensitive affordability assistance.
bills.safeguards: Prevent subsidies from simply increasing prices without expanding supply.
bills.metrics: Childcare costs as share of income; available slots.

bills.title: Paid Parental Bonding Act
bills.problem: New parents often lack protected time to bond and recover.
bills.proposedChange: Establish paid, job-protected parental leave for births and adoptions through a sustainable financing model.
bills.safeguards: Protect smaller employers and equitable access across income groups.
bills.metrics: Paid leave uptake; parent-reported financial strain.

bills.title: Voluntary Universal Preschool Act
bills.problem: Preschool access differs sharply by geography and income.
bills.proposedChange: Offer quality early education to families of three- and four-year-olds who choose it.
bills.safeguards: Preserve parental choice and avoid displacing effective existing providers.
bills.metrics: Preschool access; readiness measures; parent choice.

bills.title: Early Childhood Development Act
bills.problem: Developmental needs can go unnoticed until problems compound.
bills.proposedChange: Offer voluntary developmental screening, home visiting, and timely early interventions.
bills.safeguards: Protect family privacy and avoid overdiagnosis or coercive participation.
bills.metrics: Time to developmental support; family satisfaction.

bills.title: Every Child Can Read Act
bills.problem: Early literacy gaps compound across school years.
bills.proposedChange: Fund effective literacy instruction, educator training, and targeted tutoring.
bills.safeguards: Use independent evaluation and adapt instruction to each learner.
bills.metrics: Grade-level reading proficiency; progress among struggling readers.

bills.title: Free Healthy School Meals Act
bills.problem: Hunger and meal stigma can interfere with learning.
bills.proposedChange: Provide nutritious school breakfast and lunch without means-tested stigma.
bills.safeguards: Measure nutritional quality, waste, and cost to districts.
bills.metrics: Student food insecurity; participation; meal quality.

bills.title: School Counseling Access Act
bills.problem: Students lack timely educational and mental-health support.
bills.proposedChange: Increase access to qualified counselors and school mental-health professionals.
bills.safeguards: Avoid overloading staff and safeguard confidential student information.
bills.metrics: Counselor caseloads; wait times for student support.

bills.title: Critical Thinking and Civic Virtue Act
bills.problem: Students need skills for reasoning and constructive disagreement.
bills.proposedChange: Teach practical logic, media literacy, civil dialogue, empathy, and constitutional reasoning.
bills.safeguards: Keep curricula transparent and nonpartisan; protect freedom of conscience.
bills.metrics: Critical-thinking assessments; civic literacy; student feedback.

bills.title: Earn While You Learn Act
bills.problem: Many careers lack accessible paid training paths.
bills.proposedChange: Expand paid apprenticeships and employer-education partnerships in high-demand occupations.
bills.safeguards: Enforce training quality and prevent misuse as cheap labor.
bills.metrics: Apprenticeship completions; wages after training.

bills.title: Lifetime Learning Accounts Act
bills.problem: Adults need practical ways to gain skills across changing careers.
bills.proposedChange: Create portable education credits for qualified short courses and credentials.
bills.safeguards: Prevent low-value training providers from capturing the subsidy.
bills.metrics: Credential completion; earnings and employment after training.

bills.title: Predictable Working Hours Act
bills.problem: Unpredictable shifts disrupt childcare, sleep, and income.
bills.proposedChange: Require reasonable advance notice of schedules and compensation for certain late cancellations.
bills.safeguards: Allow genuine operational exceptions and proportionate rules for small workplaces.
bills.metrics: Schedule changes with short notice; worker income volatility.

bills.title: Paid Sick Days Act
bills.problem: Workers may feel unable to stay home when ill.
bills.proposedChange: Guarantee a modest accrual of paid sick time with anti-retaliation protections.
bills.safeguards: Design fair accrual and administrative rules for varied job types.
bills.metrics: Paid sick leave coverage; illness-related job loss.

bills.title: Family Caregiving Leave Act
bills.problem: Caring for sick relatives can create employment and financial crises.
bills.proposedChange: Offer paid caregiving leave for qualifying serious family health needs.
bills.safeguards: Protect program solvency and avoid punishing caregivers who work part-time.
bills.metrics: Caregiver leave coverage; job retention; hardship rates.

bills.title: Wage Theft Prevention Act
bills.problem: Workers sometimes do not receive pay legally owed to them.
bills.proposedChange: Improve wage enforcement, restitution speed, and protection against retaliation.
bills.safeguards: Keep complaint processes fair and accessible to both workers and employers.
bills.metrics: Recovered unpaid wages; case resolution time.

bills.title: Freedom to Practice Your Profession Act
bills.problem: Unnecessary licensing differences keep skilled people from moving or working.
bills.proposedChange: Expand license reciprocity and remove requirements unrelated to demonstrable public safety.
bills.safeguards: Retain checks for competence and professions with meaningful risks.
bills.metrics: Time to licensure; interstate workforce mobility.

bills.title: Worker Mobility Act
bills.problem: Overbroad noncompetes can block ordinary career advancement.
bills.proposedChange: Restrict noncompete clauses that unreasonably limit job changes or new businesses.
bills.safeguards: Allow legitimate protections for trade secrets and narrowly tailored confidentiality.
bills.metrics: Job mobility; wage growth; startup formation.

bills.title: Safe Work in Extreme Heat Act
bills.problem: High temperatures create preventable workplace injury risks.
bills.proposedChange: Require proportionate heat-safety plans including water, rest, shade, and acclimatization.
bills.safeguards: Adapt thresholds to actual working conditions and implementation costs.
bills.metrics: Heat-related illness at work; compliance rates.

bills.title: Employee Ownership Expansion Act
bills.problem: Many workers have little direct stake in the value they help create.
bills.proposedChange: Support voluntary employee ownership and transparent profit-sharing through targeted assistance.
bills.safeguards: Avoid concentrated retirement risk and coercive stock arrangements.
bills.metrics: Employee ownership participation; business longevity.

bills.title: Four-Day Workweek Experiment Act
bills.problem: Time pressure can undermine health and relationships.
bills.proposedChange: Fund opt-in shorter-workweek trials with independent measurement of output, staffing, and well-being.
bills.safeguards: Do not infer one work pattern suits every sector or shift worker.
bills.metrics: Productivity per hour; employee well-being; service quality.

bills.title: Right to Disconnect Act
bills.problem: Routine after-hours demands intrude on unpaid personal time.
bills.proposedChange: Protect covered workers against nonessential off-duty contact demands unless compensated or genuinely on-call.
bills.safeguards: Define emergency exceptions and fair treatment for flexible schedules.
bills.metrics: Unpaid after-hours work; worker stress; response expectations.

bills.title: Third Places for Everyone Act
bills.problem: Many people lack welcoming places to spend time without buying something.
bills.proposedChange: Support accessible noncommercial gathering spaces such as rec centers and community halls.
bills.safeguards: Provide stable operating budgets and ensure spaces welcome diverse residents.
bills.metrics: Access to free gathering spaces; repeat attendance.

bills.title: Libraries as Community Centers Act
bills.problem: Free public meeting and learning spaces are often unavailable outside work hours.
bills.proposedChange: Expand library hours, meeting rooms, and community programs where demand supports them.
bills.safeguards: Protect library independence and balance staffing and security needs.
bills.metrics: Evening hours; program participation; free room availability.

bills.title: A Park in Every Neighborhood Act
bills.problem: Unequal park access limits play, exercise, and contact with nature.
bills.proposedChange: Prioritize safe, accessible parks and playgrounds in neighborhoods with the biggest deficits.
bills.safeguards: Fund maintenance, accessibility, and neighborhood input.
bills.metrics: Residents within a short walk of a park; park usage.

bills.title: Community Dinner Act
bills.problem: Neighbors have too few easy opportunities to meet each other.
bills.proposedChange: Offer small competitive grants for free, welcoming community meals.
bills.safeguards: Use transparent selection and food safety practices; avoid exclusion.
bills.metrics: Attendance diversity; repeat participation; participant satisfaction.

bills.title: Community Clubs Starter Act
bills.problem: Social activities often fail because organizers lack small startup resources.
bills.proposedChange: Provide microgrants and meeting access for recurring community groups.
bills.safeguards: Keep grants viewpoint-neutral and ensure simple reporting.
bills.metrics: Number of active clubs; sustained participation.

bills.title: Youth Mentorship for All Act
bills.problem: Young people may lack supportive adults outside their households.
bills.proposedChange: Increase access to supervised mentoring programs with vetted, trained volunteers.
bills.safeguards: Require child-safety checks, clear consent, and program evaluation.
bills.metrics: Mentoring relationship retention; youth-reported support.

bills.title: Intergenerational Friendship Act
bills.problem: Age segregation reduces opportunities to share skills and companionship.
bills.proposedChange: Support voluntary activities connecting older and younger residents.
bills.safeguards: Provide safeguarding, accessibility, and meaningful mutual participation.
bills.metrics: Cross-age program participation; loneliness indicators.

bills.title: Social Connection Prescription Act
bills.problem: Loneliness is not always addressed by clinical care alone.
bills.proposedChange: Pilot voluntary referrals from providers to vetted clubs, classes, and community groups.
bills.safeguards: Do not medicalize ordinary solitude or replace needed clinical treatment.
bills.metrics: Follow-through on referrals; perceived social support.

bills.title: Public Arts and Music Act
bills.problem: Creative opportunities can be inaccessible or concentrated in a few communities.
bills.proposedChange: Support local arts studios, concerts, theater, and low-cost creative instruction.
bills.safeguards: Award funding transparently with artistic independence.
bills.metrics: Community arts participation; access by neighborhood.

bills.title: Volunteer Without Barriers Act
bills.problem: Travel and caregiving expenses prevent willing residents from volunteering.
bills.proposedChange: Reimburse qualifying childcare, transport, and accessibility expenses for approved volunteer work.
bills.safeguards: Keep paperwork light and avoid displacing paid work.
bills.metrics: Volunteer participation; volunteer retention; reimbursement uptake.

bills.title: Civil Justice for Everyone Act
bills.problem: People often face severe civil problems without legal help.
bills.proposedChange: Expand legal support for qualifying housing, debt, family, and other high-stakes civil matters.
bills.safeguards: Preserve attorney independence and set clear eligibility rules.
bills.metrics: Unrepresented case share; fair-resolution outcomes.

bills.title: Second Chance Records Act
bills.problem: Old records can create lifelong barriers after rehabilitation.
bills.proposedChange: Seal eligible criminal records after suitable periods and conditions, with public-safety exceptions.
bills.safeguards: Balance rehabilitation, victim interests, and safety-sensitive screening.
bills.metrics: Employment after record sealing; recidivism; processing time.

bills.title: Effective Public Defense Act
bills.problem: Underfunded defense can undermine fair criminal proceedings.
bills.proposedChange: Fund public defender staffing, training, and manageable caseloads.
bills.safeguards: Protect independent legal representation and outcome transparency.
bills.metrics: Defender caseloads; access to counsel; case delays.

bills.title: Restorative Justice Choice Act
bills.problem: Traditional proceedings may leave some victims and communities without meaningful repair.
bills.proposedChange: Provide professionally supervised, voluntary restorative processes for carefully screened cases.
bills.safeguards: Require informed victim consent and forbid coercive participation.
bills.metrics: Victim satisfaction; agreements completed; reoffending.

bills.title: Fair Jury Service Act
bills.problem: Lost wages and dependent care make jury service inaccessible to many.
bills.proposedChange: Increase juror compensation and reimburse essential care and travel expenses.
bills.safeguards: Keep selection fair and ensure genuine funding.
bills.metrics: Juror hardship exemptions; jury representativeness.

bills.title: Survivor Safety and Independence Act
bills.problem: People facing domestic violence or stalking need reliable escape and recovery support.
bills.proposedChange: Expand confidential emergency housing, protective services, and legal assistance.
bills.safeguards: Prioritize survivor consent, privacy, and effective safety planning.
bills.metrics: Survivor access to safe housing; repeat victimization.

bills.title: Disability Inclusion by Design Act
bills.problem: Physical and digital barriers exclude people from everyday participation.
bills.proposedChange: Strengthen accessible public services, transit, buildings, and government websites.
bills.safeguards: Set achievable schedules and consult people with disabilities directly.
bills.metrics: Accessibility compliance; service access complaints.

bills.title: Aging With Dignity at Home Act
bills.problem: Older adults may lack supports needed to remain in familiar communities.
bills.proposedChange: Expand home modifications, community-based care, and respite options for carers.
bills.safeguards: Protect choice, quality, and fiscal sustainability.
bills.metrics: Avoidable institutionalization; caregiver burnout; home care access.

bills.title: Foster Youth Independence Act
bills.problem: Young people leaving foster care face abrupt loss of support.
bills.proposedChange: Provide transition housing, education assistance, and career support for eligible young adults.
bills.safeguards: Center youth consent and track outcomes beyond program participation.
bills.metrics: Stable housing after foster care; education and employment outcomes.

bills.title: Community Conflict Resolution Act
bills.problem: Minor disputes can escalate into expensive and damaging legal conflicts.
bills.proposedChange: Make voluntary, qualified mediation accessible for suitable civil and neighborhood disagreements.
bills.safeguards: Do not pressure vulnerable parties to settle or undermine legal rights.
bills.metrics: Mediation resolution rate; repeated disputes; participant satisfaction.

bills.title: Secure and Convenient Voting Act
bills.problem: Some eligible voters face avoidable participation barriers while election security requires public confidence.
bills.proposedChange: Expand accessible voting options and require verifiable paper-backed audits and transparent security standards.
bills.safeguards: Respect state administration and protect eligibility, privacy, and accessibility.
bills.metrics: Eligible voter participation; audit completion; access barriers.

bills.title: Citizen Legislative Agenda Act
bills.problem: Residents struggle to move serious proposals onto legislative agendas.
bills.proposedChange: Require public hearings for proposals exceeding verified constituent support thresholds.
bills.safeguards: Prevent spam, identity abuse, and disproportionate influence by organized groups.
bills.metrics: Eligible petitions heard; time to hearing; participation diversity.

bills.title: Citizens' Assembly Act
bills.problem: Complex public issues need informed deliberation beyond polarized debates.
bills.proposedChange: Convene paid, randomly selected resident panels to study questions and publish recommendations.
bills.safeguards: Make sampling representative and recommendations advisory, not binding.
bills.metrics: Assembly completion; participant diversity; transparency measures.

bills.title: Transparent Political Influence Act
bills.problem: Citizens cannot always see who funds or influences government decisions.
bills.proposedChange: Improve timely disclosure of lobbying and significant political financing.
bills.safeguards: Respect constitutional speech and association protections and legitimate privacy.
bills.metrics: Disclosure timeliness; compliance rates; public access.

bills.title: Every Bill in Plain English Act
bills.problem: Long legal documents are difficult for ordinary people to evaluate.
bills.proposedChange: Publish accessible summaries of major bills, including costs, effects, and uncertainty, alongside full text.
bills.safeguards: Prevent misleading summaries and preserve access to authoritative legal language.
bills.metrics: Summary availability; comprehension testing; correction rate.

bills.title: National Flourishing Budget Act
bills.problem: Budgets track spending more readily than improvements in lived conditions.
bills.proposedChange: Publish privacy-preserving outcome dashboards alongside fiscal reporting for major programs.
bills.safeguards: Avoid simplistic happiness targets and manipulation of self-reported measures.
bills.metrics: Coverage of validated well-being indicators; public data quality.

bills.title: Open Government Contracting Act
bills.problem: Opaque procurement erodes accountability and may waste public funds.
bills.proposedChange: Publish searchable public contracts, awards, and performance records with limited justified exceptions.
bills.safeguards: Protect legitimate security needs and commercially sensitive details.
bills.metrics: Public contract transparency; competitive bidding rates.

bills.title: Government Must Respond Act
bills.problem: Slow and opaque government services create stress and lost opportunities.
bills.proposedChange: Set status tracking, response targets, and appeals for essential applications and requests.
bills.safeguards: Fund agency capacity and distinguish deadlines from automatic approvals.
bills.metrics: Median service time; unresolved backlog; successful appeals.

bills.title: Evidence-Based Government Act
bills.problem: Public programs can continue without reliable evidence of effectiveness.
bills.proposedChange: Require independent evaluations and transparent continuation decisions for major programs.
bills.safeguards: Account for long-term outcomes that cannot be measured quickly.
bills.metrics: Evaluations published; follow-up actions; program outcomes.

bills.title: Participatory Budgeting Act
bills.problem: Residents have limited direct influence over some local spending choices.
bills.proposedChange: Dedicate a transparent share of qualifying local funds to resident-designed and selected projects.
bills.safeguards: Protect core services and guard against manipulation and unequal turnout.
bills.metrics: Projects completed; participation diversity; resident satisfaction.

bills.title: Personal Data Privacy Act
bills.problem: People often lack control over collection and resale of personal data.
bills.proposedChange: Create enforceable limits on collection, use, retention, and disclosure with stronger safeguards for sensitive information.
bills.safeguards: Protect small organizations' ability to comply and preserve useful research under safeguards.
bills.metrics: Privacy complaints; unwanted data sharing; enforcement outcomes.

bills.title: Human Appeal of AI Decisions Act
bills.problem: Automated systems can make consequential mistakes without usable appeal routes.
bills.proposedChange: Provide explanations and meaningful human review for high-impact automated decisions.
bills.safeguards: Define material decisions and ensure reviewers can actually reverse errors.
bills.metrics: Appeal time; error reversal rate; access to explanations.

bills.title: Public Algorithm Accountability Act
bills.problem: High-impact government AI tools can obscure bias and error.
bills.proposedChange: Require risk assessments, testing, and proportionate independent audits for government AI systems.
bills.safeguards: Publish useful oversight without exposing security vulnerabilities or personal data.
bills.metrics: Audits completed; errors identified and corrected.

bills.title: Choose Your Algorithm Act
bills.problem: Users may have little say over how platforms rank what they see.
bills.proposedChange: Require meaningful feed controls and a non-personalized chronological option where practicable.
bills.safeguards: Protect platform innovation and prevent deceptive or hard-to-find settings.
bills.metrics: Feed control adoption; user understanding; complaints.

bills.title: Children's Digital Safety by Design Act
bills.problem: Online services can expose children to privacy and safety risks.
bills.proposedChange: Require age-appropriate privacy and safety defaults, independently audited for high-risk services.
bills.safeguards: Preserve minors' privacy and rights to information; avoid blanket surveillance.
bills.metrics: Youth privacy incidents; safety-control effectiveness.

bills.title: Affordable Broadband Access Act
bills.problem: Inadequate internet access limits learning and opportunity.
bills.proposedChange: Expand reliable broadband availability and affordable service in underserved areas.
bills.safeguards: Target actual gaps and discourage ineffective subsidies.
bills.metrics: Households with affordable reliable broadband; outage frequency.

bills.title: Right to Repair and Maintain Act
bills.problem: Repair restrictions can force people to replace useful products.
bills.proposedChange: Require fair access to repair parts, documentation, and tools for covered products.
bills.safeguards: Protect safety, cybersecurity, and genuine intellectual-property interests.
bills.metrics: Repair costs; device lifespan; repair market availability.

bills.title: Tell the Government Once Act
bills.problem: People repeatedly submit the same information to different offices.
bills.proposedChange: Enable authorized, secure reuse of verified information across public services.
bills.safeguards: Use data minimization, consent or legal basis, and strong access controls.
bills.metrics: Repeated form fields eliminated; application time; privacy incidents.

bills.title: Protection Against Deceptive AI Impersonation Act
bills.problem: Fraudulent synthetic media can damage reputations and deceive victims.
bills.proposedChange: Create proportionate remedies for harmful deceptive impersonation and related fraud.
bills.safeguards: Safeguard satire, criticism, research, and lawful expression.
bills.metrics: Impersonation complaints; remedy time; false-positive enforcement.

bills.title: Public Futures Simulation Act
bills.problem: Policy debates often hide assumptions about long-term effects.
bills.proposedChange: Publish transparent scenario models for major proposals when feasible, with uncertainty and reproducible assumptions.
bills.safeguards: Do not treat modeled outcomes as predictions or allow opaque scoring to decide policy.
bills.metrics: Models reproducible; assumptions disclosed; post-policy validation.

bills.title: Lead-Free Drinking Water Infrastructure Act
bills.problem: Lead exposure from water infrastructure harms health, especially children.
bills.proposedChange: Prioritize replacement of hazardous lead service lines and reliable water testing.
bills.safeguards: Balance cost, accurate inventories, and fair prioritization of highest exposure.
bills.metrics: Lead lines replaced; water lead test results.

bills.title: Clean Air for Every Child Act
bills.problem: Poor indoor and outdoor air exposes children to avoidable health risks.
bills.proposedChange: Improve school ventilation, air monitoring, and protection from excessive nearby pollution.
bills.safeguards: Use transparent standards and realistic funding for ongoing maintenance.
bills.metrics: School air quality; asthma-related absenteeism.

bills.title: Cooler Cities Act
bills.problem: Dangerous urban heat disproportionately affects vulnerable residents.
bills.proposedChange: Fund shade, water access, trees, and cooling infrastructure in high-risk neighborhoods.
bills.safeguards: Select measures for local climate and long-term maintenance.
bills.metrics: Heat-related illness; shaded pedestrian routes; surface temperatures.

bills.title: No Preventable Road Deaths Act
bills.problem: Serious road crashes cause avoidable deaths and injuries.
bills.proposedChange: Prioritize proven safety design for intersections, road speeds, and vulnerable road users.
bills.safeguards: Evaluate access and emergency response alongside safety outcomes.
bills.metrics: Traffic fatalities and serious injuries; high-risk crossings improved.

bills.title: Reliable Public Transit Act
bills.problem: Infrequent or inaccessible transport restricts jobs and daily life.
bills.proposedChange: Improve bus and rail reliability and suitable demand-responsive services where needed.
bills.safeguards: Design service around actual rider demand and sustainable operations.
bills.metrics: Transit wait time; accessibility; reliable trip completion.

bills.title: Neighborhood Disaster Preparedness Act
bills.problem: Local emergencies can overwhelm households with inadequate warnings and support.
bills.proposedChange: Create accessible emergency plans, warning systems, evacuation support, and resilient local facilities.
bills.safeguards: Keep plans current and include people with disabilities and limited mobility.
bills.metrics: Warning reach; evacuation readiness; recovery time.

bills.title: Clean Energy Connection Act
bills.problem: Aging electricity systems constrain reliable clean energy deployment.
bills.proposedChange: Modernize grids and accelerate responsible transmission, storage, and generation permits.
bills.safeguards: Preserve environmental review and address ratepayer and community impacts.
bills.metrics: Grid reliability; connection queue delays; emissions intensity.

bills.title: Nature Within Reach Act
bills.problem: Many residents lack convenient access to restored and protected nature.
bills.proposedChange: Expand habitat restoration and public access to trails, green corridors, and natural sites.
bills.safeguards: Protect biodiversity and access for historically underserved communities.
bills.metrics: Habitat restored; residents near accessible natural space.

bills.title: Feed People, Not Landfills Act
bills.problem: Usable food is discarded while some households face food insecurity.
bills.proposedChange: Support safe food rescue, donation logistics, and transparent food-waste reduction programs.
bills.safeguards: Maintain food safety and avoid costly low-impact mandates.
bills.metrics: Edible food recovered; food waste per resident.

bills.title: Future Generations Protection Act
bills.problem: Short-term policy choices can create long-lasting costs for children and future residents.
bills.proposedChange: Require independent long-term impact reports for major legislation on fiscal, environmental, and generational outcomes.
bills.safeguards: Avoid speculative precision and protect democratic decision-making authority.
bills.metrics: Long-term assessments published; assumptions and revisions tracked.
